ground_truth.title: New Tank Setup Opinions
ground_truth.main_content:
Hey guys, First time posting here. I got into the hobby about three/four years ago. Started with a 5 gallon. Upgraded to a 22 gal long and just recently bought a 42 gal. This will be my third scape. The new tank will swap out the 22 gal. But I need some help deciding on the layout. You will see three options I came up with so far in pictures attached. I plane to have inlet and outlet on right side. Oase Biomaster 350 with inline C02 diffuser. I plan to use the plants from the 22 gal. Probably add Pinnatifida. Substrate will be 50/50 crushed lava rock and Fluval Stratum in the back for Bacopa. I'll probably use the Parva at the front left and right corners and/or S. Repens. Pool filter sand will be used at the front/middle. Epiphytes will be Java Fern, Buce, Anubias. Hardscape is Icelandic Lava Rock and Hornwood I believe. I look forward to the input and recommendations. Cheers!

I like the first layout the best. It caught my eye even before I expanded the thumbnails.

I like your 3rd layout (3760), but I tend to prefer aquascapes with more height. Especially if it breaks through the surface. The arch layouts work too, but maybe don’t force them to connect. It looks a little unnatural to me. Take my advice with a grain of salt. Your other scape looks great. And I’m sure any scape will look awesome with the plant selection you have planned.

^agreed They all look good but do you want more natural? If so an arch isn’t.

Yea I’m in the process of building the third rendition. Thanks!

i prefer the third 3760, although they all look great. sheesh your 22L looks great too
